name: Nigerian Fruit Skewer
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Cut all the fruit into small chunks.
Thread the fruit chunks onto a skewer.

culture.text: A skewer is a thin metal or wood stick used to hold pieces of food together. The word may sometimes be used as a metonym, to refer to the entire food item served on a skewer, as in "chicken skewers". Skewers are used while grilling or roasting meats and fish, and in other culinary applications.
